summary: Sabre Corp filed an 8-K reporting that indirect subsidiary Sabre Financial Borrower LLC issued $1.35 billion of 9.875% senior secured notes due October 15, 2032, under a new indenture with Wilmington Trust as trustee and collateral agent. Proceeds were on-lent to Sabre GLBL, which prepaid its existing first lien intercompany loan and repurchased $251.9 million of 10.750% 2029 notes; Sabre Financial repurchased $930.7 million of its 11.125% 2029 SPV notes and discharged that indenture. This is a debt refinancing, not a special situation.
